title: Advisor filter on the expanded Billing Efficiency chart
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two staff members act as service advisors on work orders (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen and Priya Raman).
  5. Each of those advisors has an invoiced work order with clocked time this month (the QA Testing workplace has this). If not, create one per advisor:
    • Customers > New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer") and save.
    • Work Orders > New Work Order, pick that customer and an asset (use Add in the dialog if the customer has no asset), then Create.
    • In the work order header set the service advisor (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen).
    • On the Lines tab click New Line and add a labor line with labor hours (e.g. 1.00) and a price (e.g. $250.00), and assign a technician to the line (e.g. Grace Sullivan).
    • Sign in as that technician in a second browser, clock in on that line, and clock out after a known time (e.g. 15 minutes, which is 0.25 hours). Sign out of the second browser.
    • Back as Admin: approve the line, complete the work order and click Review.
    • Open the Finance tab and click Create Invoice. The invoice is dated today. Close the payment dialog that opens.
    • Repeat with a second customer and the second advisor (e.g. Priya Raman).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Billing Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Read the filter button at the top right of the Billing Efficiency chart and the chart's legend.
  4. Click the filter button and read the list.
  5. Choose one advisor (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen).
  6. Try to choose a second advisor as well.
  7. Read the chart's legend and lines.
  8. Clear the advisor choice so no advisor is chosen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Billing Efficiency chart has an Advisor filter.
  • Before anything is chosen, the chart shows every advisor (the legend lists all of them).
  • Only one advisor can be chosen at a time: choosing a second one replaces the first.
  • With one advisor chosen the chart reloads and shows only that advisor's line.
  • With the choice cleared, all advisors show again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. Split out of C88619.
